verdict.rationale: Poke offers a programmatic API for sending messages, which reaches its conversational capabilities, and external services can trigger it. A CLI also covers login, adding MCP servers, tunneling and recipe creation. Many UI-side functions have no documented API equivalent: managing integrations (connect, disconnect, refresh), account merging, buying credits and auto-reload, and Kitchen payouts are all described only as UI flows. No OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: a documented full API surface, API endpoints for integration, account and billing management, an OpenAPI/reference spec, and independent confirmation of UI–API parity.
